##### Project general facts

Lunara Residence by Cavara Developments, presents an intimate boutique tower that reinterprets residential design through a timeless architectural language. This intimate collection of studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom residences has been designed with intention, where every element is shaped to create a sense of balance, warmth, and timeless character. The result is a residence that feels personal, distinctive, and effortlessly sophisticated — a place where boutique living is reimagined through refined architectural language and carefully considered details.

The interiors of Lunara Residence are defined by warm, natural materials that create an atmosphere of refined elegance, where every detail has been thoughtfully selected to reflect the residence's boutique character. Floor-to-ceiling windows fill each home with natural light while opening views across the surrounding cityscape, creating living spaces that feel both serene and connected. Rich textures, warm finishes, and thoughtful details create a sense of intimacy throughout, from the welcoming lobby to the private comfort of every residence, ensuring that each home feels personal rather than imposing.

Beyond the exquisite residences, Lunara Residence offers a curated collection of amenities designed to enhance wellbeing, relaxation, and connection. Residents enjoy an outdoor swimming pool for adults and children complete with showers, sunbeds, and private cabanas, alongside an open-air cinema, outdoor sport zone, gym, and dedicated kids' play area. The development also features a refined lounge lobby, indoor lounge zone, open-air lounge area, and outdoor yoga space, creating a sanctuary where every moment is enriched by thoughtful design and enduring quality.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Garden City occupies a rare position at the heart of Dubai, offering a serene and established community that blends the energy of Sheikh Zayed Road with the relaxed rhythm of one of the city's most desirable neighbourhoods. This vibrant and walkable area brings together the character of old Dubai with a contemporary way of living, surrounded by dining, culture, and the city's key destinations. Lunara Residence places the city within effortless reach, with Downtown Dubai, City Walk, Jumeirah Beach, Business Bay, and Dubai World Trade Centre all just minutes away.

Life within Jumeirah Garden City is defined by its exceptional connectivity and unmatched convenience, with the World Trade Centre Metro Station nearby for seamless city-wide connectivity and Dubai International Airport just a short journey away. The neighbourhood's strategic position places residents within moments of Dubai's most iconic landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Museum of the Future, Dubai Frame, and La Mer Beach, all within an easy drive. This is a place where every destination is always within reach, yet the neighbourhood retains its intimate, community-focused character that feels wonderfully removed from the ordinary.

The surroundings of Jumeirah Garden City offer a wealth of attractions and experiences that cater to every interest and lifestyle, from world-class shopping at City Walk and Dubai Mall to cultural treasures like the Etihad Museum and Jumeirah Mosque. The area's prestigious hotels, including the Fairmont Dubai, Conrad Dubai, and The Ritz-Carlton DIFC, along with its vibrant dining and entertainment scene, ensure that every desire is always within easy reach. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the authenticity and charm of a historic neighbourhood with the dynamic allure of one of the world's most exciting cities.
